category_edits.rationale: Test pairwise softplus ranking loss plus 0.2-weighted pointwise logistic supervision to constrain score drift on the unit-normalized incumbent. Apply across all four datasets, preserving nonpadding averaging, sampling, model architecture, inference, optimizer and training settings.

edits.replace:
pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores - pos_scores)
    pointwise_loss = (
        torch.nn.functional.softplus(-pos_scores)
        + torch.nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores)
    )
    loss = pairwise_loss + 0.2 * pointwise_loss
    return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

change_summary: Replace BPR with stable pairwise softplus plus 0.2-weighted pointwise logistic loss. Predictor and checkpoint shapes remain unchanged.
